name: A Firm Response
summary: Ayessa Dawnsinger answers the High Order’s intrusion on Zephras Isle with force. She sends you after Belathaan Brightwish on the road north to the Shrine of Akir, to make the Windshapers’ boundaries clear.

sections.title: Drawing the Line
sections.body: The Windshapers of Zephras Isle will not accept the High Order’s secretive scrutiny. Their warnings have gone unheeded, so Ayessa Dawnsinger escalates the dispute. She sends you to intercept Belathaan Brightwish on the lonely road north to the Shrine of Akir, away from prying eyes in town.

sections.title: Storms on the Road
sections.body: Belathaan Brightwish travels north toward the ancient Shrine of Akir, and his purpose is unclear. When you confront him on the secluded road, he turns hostile, and Living Storms join the fight. Defeating the elementals and humbling Belathaan sends the High Order a clear message: the Windshapers answer interference with force.

faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger belongs to the Horde-aligned Windshapers on Zephras Isle. She protects their domain and acts ruthlessly against intruders who meddle in their affairs.
Belathaan Brightwish is tied to the High Order. Ayessa Dawnsinger targets him to intimidate the organization after he is spotted heading alone toward the Shrine of Akir.
The High Order is a faction on Zephras Isle whose activities conflict with those of the local Windshapers. It keeps probing into their affairs despite explicit warnings.

faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Akir located?
faq.answer: The Shrine of Akir lies north of town on Zephras Isle. Belathaan is intercepted on the secluded road that leads there.

faq.q: Why does Ayessa want Belathaan beaten rather than killed?
faq.answer: Ayessa wants Belathaan beaten to send a message without starting a total war. She hopes he will return to his superiors with fear and respect for the Windshapers’ boundaries.

faq.q: What are the Living Storms encountered during this task?
faq.answer: Living Storms are elemental entities that appear during the confrontation with Belathaan on the road. They reflect Zephras Isle’s volatile elemental energies.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde on Zephras Isle, you help secure its positions and keep rivals like the High Order from encroaching on allied interests.
As a shaman, you face Living Storms amid the turbulent, untamed elemental air magic found across Zephras Isle.
